embedding.query_prefix: Represent this sentence for searching relevant passages:

protocol.weight_rule: dev if present, else train, else fixed 0.5
protocol.bm25: Bm25Index(k1=0.9, b=0.4, lucene lengths, anserini_english), title\ntext

significance.multiple_comparisons: Holm-Bonferroni over all method pairs, per metric

bm25.configuration_notes: flat: title and text concatenated into one 'contents' field (BeirFlatCollection, title + "\n" + text); not multifield
bm25.evaluation: trec_eval -c -m ndcg_cut.10 / recall.100 / recall.1000 on beir-v1.0.0-scifact.test (300 queries)
bm25.also_checked: Same values on master at 6caeb33a27385d6acc726d81874e34d3a567f46f (2026-08-16), the last commit touching the config
